notes: (1) true: GGPY give infinitely many x with x, x+1 of pattern {2,1,1,1,B-1} for each B >= 2, distinct patterns, so infinitely many terms. (2) proved for every signature containing {2,1,1,1} (GGPY triple with adjoined factors of signature mu, paper argument); otherwise open: no consecutive powerful pair up to 10^15 has equal signatures (25 pairs; Myers checked 3e8); Dickson's conjecture for two linear forms implies (2) for every signature with an exponent 1. Outside Lean: GGPY's theorem; (2) itself is open.

sources.cite: D. A. Goldston, S. W. Graham, J. Pintz, C. Y. Yildirim, Small gaps between almost primes, the parity problem and some conjectures of Erdos on consecutive integers, IMRN 2011, arXiv:0803.2636

prior_art.note: Part (1) follows from GGPY; part (2) open.
